items.statement: With one attendance-equivalent definition and all referrals in the denominator, completion of remote rehabilitation differs from centre-based completion by less than 8 percentage points after adjustment.
items.rationale: The board's decision needs the adjusted difference; randomised evidence suggests a small difference once definitions are aligned.

items.statement: Remote rehabilitation raises completion for patients living more than 40 km away.
items.rationale: Distance lowers centre completion; remote delivery removes the journey.
items.risks: Few distant patients choose the centre programme.

items.statement: Remote completion is lower for women, people aged 75 or over and people in the most deprived areas.
items.rationale: Dropout predictors in remote programmes point this way.
